raw_posts.name: Product Hunt Visual Launch Editor
raw_posts.tagline: See your launch as you build it
raw_posts.description: See your Product Hunt launch come to life as you build it! The new visual editor lets you edit your launch in fewer steps while while automatically saving your draft. You can simply click the name, tagline, gallery or makers to edit them in place. A checklist shows what's required and what will help your launch stand out, and clicking a checklist item will take you straight to the field that needs work. Drafts, scheduled launches and live launches now all use the same editor.

raw_posts.name: MOVO AI
raw_posts.tagline: The world's first long-form video agent for mobile
raw_posts.description: MOVO AI is the world’s first AI video agent for long-form creation that works right from your phone. It also works on the web. Shoot, upload, or start with an idea, then tell MOVO AI what you want. MOVO plans, creates, refines, keeps characters and scenes consistent, and brings the whole video together. Lock your phone and MOVO keeps working. Come back to review or make changes through chat. No prompt gymnastics. No canvas-heavy workflows. No manual clip stitching.

raw_posts.name: Agent Hunt
raw_posts.tagline: Live rankings of the tools AI agents use most
raw_posts.description: Agent Hunt is a live leaderboard of the tools AI agents actually use. Every place is earned by real calls agents make through Monid.

raw_posts.name: Ovren Live Preview
raw_posts.tagline: See your product change live before it ships
raw_posts.description: Describe a change in plain words. Ovren writes the code on a safe copy of your project and gives you a live preview of every frontend change — your real page, with the change on it. Click through it, approve it, and your team merges the pull request.

raw_posts.name: ElevenLabs Realtime
raw_posts.tagline: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio
raw_posts.description: Eleven Realtime is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for voice agents. Speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice are tuned end-to-end. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, v1 Max for complex tasks, with 620ms and 570ms to first audio. It supports 90+ languages and works in ElevenAgents or through an OpenAI-compatible Realtime API, so you only change the endpoint and model name.

raw_posts.name: ShogunAI
raw_posts.tagline: Your personal AGI on your pc
raw_posts.description: An AI assistant that remembers your work and helps with meeting prep, search, writing and follow-ups. Try ShogunAI for Mac free for 7 days.

raw_posts.name: FLUX 3 Max
raw_posts.tagline: fal’s FLUX 3 Max: 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds
raw_posts.description: FLUX 3 Max is fal’s post-trained text-to-video and image-to-video model, built with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 base. fal says it generates a 10-second 720p clip in about 12 seconds, around 10x faster than FLUX 3. It is tied for #1 on a preliminary Artificial Analysis image-to-video board. Pricing is $0.0425 per second of video through November 7 (list $0.17), with a playground and API.

raw_posts.name: Cloudflare Clairic
raw_posts.tagline: Cloudflare's AI model for fast, cheap data extraction
raw_posts.description: Clairic is Cloudflare's new AI model for extracting structured information without generating tokens. Give it messy text or images, and it returns typed values like names, dates, amounts, calculations, and estimates in a single pass, with confidence scores. Built for developers who need faster, cheaper data processing than traditional LLM calls. Available in preview on Workers AI at $0.10 per million input tokens, with open weights planned.

raw_posts.name: Context Engine
raw_posts.tagline: One memory for your AI agents and human team members.
raw_posts.description: Context Engine is one memory for your AI agents and your team. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code save to it as they work, and the people on your team read it, ask it questions and add files. Free to start.
